answer: Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. By the atlas of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, converted to a slow vesting stream, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. The vine is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the yarrow.
